legend: Consider the following graph in the shape of n$$$n$$$ equilateral triangles stitched together horizontally:
This graph has n+2$$$n+2$$$ vertices and 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ edges. The vertices are labeled in the order of increasing horizontal position, as in the image above.
In other words, the graph has n+2$$$n+2$$$ vertices labeled from 1$$$1$$$ through n+2$$$n+2$$$, and 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ edges connecting all pairs of vertices whose labels differ by at most 2$$$2$$$.

A positive integer value is assigned to each vertex. Vertex i$$$i$$$ has the value of vi$$$v_i$$$. The value of an edge that connects vertices i$$$i$$$ and j$$$j$$$ is |vi−vj|$$$|v_i - v_j|$$$. Find a way to assign values to all vertices so that for every positive integer k$$$k$$$ up to 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ inclusive, exactly one edge has the value of k$$$k$$$. The value of any vertex cannot exceed 1018$$$10^{18}$$$.
input: The first line contains n$$$n$$$, a positive integer.
output: If a solution exists for the given n$$$n$$$, print the values assigned to the vertices 1,2,…,n+2$$$1, 2, \ldots, n+2$$$ in one line, separated by spaces. The values must be positive integers not exceeding 1018$$$10^{18}$$$. Otherwise, print −1$$$-1$$$.

legend.ai: 考虑如下图所示的、由 n$$$n$$$ 个等边三角形沿水平方向拼接而成的图：
该图有 n+2$$$n+2$$$ 个顶点和 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ 条边。顶点按照水平位置递增的顺序编号，如上图所示。
换句话说，该图有 n+2$$$n+2$$$ 个顶点，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n+2$$$n+2$$$，并有 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ 条边，连接所有编号之差不超过 2$$$2$$$ 的顶点对。

每个顶点都被赋予一个正整数值。顶点 i$$$i$$$ 的值为 vi$$$v_i$$$。连接顶点 i$$$i$$$ 和 j$$$j$$$ 的边的值为 |vi−vj|$$$|v_i - v_j|$$$。请找到一种为所有顶点赋值的方法，使得对于每个不超过 2n+1$$$2n+1$$$ 的正整数 k$$$k$$$，恰好有一条边的值为 k$$$k$$$。任何顶点的值都不能超过 1018$$$10^{18}$$$。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个正整数 n$$$n$$$。

output.ai: 如果对于给定的 n$$$n$$$ 存在解，请在一行中输出分配给顶点 1,2,…,n+2$$$1, 2, \ldots, n+2$$$ 的值，并以空格分隔。这些值必须是不超过 1018$$$10^{18}$$$ 的正整数。否则，输出 −1$$$-1$$$。
